question: THE ONTOLOGY CLOSEOUT: the dark mass's status after the effective reading + the charge lean. (1) the three-way closeout -- (a) Gauss-map charge of the sourced field (G154: M_ph(<r) = M_b r/r_M, assigned, Lean-certified G227 C4), (b) the relic m = 5.09 keV (G212), disfavored (G215: 19 vs 5.1/1.0, 3.2/4.1 sigma), (c) the effective reading (H054: no particle -- the mass is the equilibrium's, the charge unassigned) -- each ontology's requirements, the committed deciding test (G156 pre-registration + the field-detection falsifier), the standing with the decision tree; (2) the dissolution question (O3) -- the test that still requires a separate substance, and the framework's committed answers (cluster thermometer, pie, dSph floor -- all the equilibrium's); (3) verdicts V1/V2/V3.

checks.name: C1 [the three-way statuses are stated with their requirements]
checks.measured: (a) Gauss-map charge: a carrier exists = the sourced field's surface term M_ph(<r) = M_b r/r_M, M_ph(<r_M) = M_b exact, Lean-certified (G227 C4); requires R(k) = 1, no free-streaming, rising sub-halo slope (63.1 over 1e5->1e7). (b) relic: a particle species m = 5.09 +- 0.10 keV, lambda_fs = 0.558 Mpc, M_hm 7.3e5-8.4e6 Msun, SHMF inversion. (c) effective reading: no carrier at all -- the mass is the baryonic+DE equilibrium's statistics; J^0 = 0 (G154 R2); predicts nulls.
checks.reading: each ontology is a falsifiable package: (a) requires a field-carried charge and no particle scale; (b) requires a particle-imprint (inversion/cutoff); (c) requires every DM observable to be reproducible from the distribution alone.

checks.name: C2 [the committed deciding tests exist and are mutually exclusive]
checks.measured: G156: RELIC on 95% slope inversion <= 0.5 at M_hm in [5e5, 5.8e6] (m_WDM 5.6-8.3 keV); CHARGE on 1e6-1e7 within [0.5, 1.5] x CDM (m_hm < 1.6e6). Field-detection falsifier (H054 C2): any environment-independent fifth force/scalar wave/DM particle kills (c). G168 kill band: forest/sterile m < 4 or m > 6 keV kills the triangle.
checks.reading: the two G156 rules cannot both hold at percent precision; the field-detection falsifier is registered, not retrospective; the decision lives in the 1e5-1e8 dark-halo decade.

checks.name: C3 [the relic's lean is quantified and its formal boundary stated]
checks.measured: N_obs(>1e5 RAR) = 19 vs 5.107 (5.7 keV) / 1.005 (3.3 keV): z = 3.187 / 4.128 sigma (re-derived, matches G215); S_meas = 1.0 vs 0.269 / 0.053; subhalo-probe 95% bounds (6.2-9.7 keV) above m = 5.09 keV; formal RELIC declaration still awaits the 95% dark-halo slope inversion; the 5.7-8.33 keV window survives only behind convention factors x2.7-9.7.
checks.reading: the relic is lean-ruled-out (count-level, lower window excluded, pressed from above), not formally DECIDED-against -- the honest boundary is the unmeasured dark-halo decade.

checks.name: C4 [the effective reading's falsifier and its observable overlap with (a) are stated]
checks.measured: (c) is falsified by any fundamental field/particle detection (H054 C2) or a universal a0 gap (H054 C4); (a) and (c) agree on every sub-halo observable (both R(k) = 1) and differ only on whether the field has independent dynamics / 'charge' language survives the static branch.
checks.reading: the a/(c) boundary is not the census (they predict the same counts) -- it is dynamics: mass-source separation, beyond-envelope mass, or a measured particle outside the equilibrium routes.

checks.name: C5 [the dissolution test is stated: what observable still requires a separate substance]
checks.measured: six signatures: (i) mass separated from its baryonic source (offset collisions); (ii) a measured particle m (forest/sterile in [4.6, 5.2] keV confirms the triangle); (iii) particle-imprint: lambda_fs > 0, R(k) < 1, 95% SHMF inversion; (iv) dynamics decoupled from the equilibrium (independent Jeans scale, self-interaction, non-thermodynamic relaxation); (v) mass beyond the pie line or the EFE cap sqrt(a0/g_ext) M_b = 0.660 M_b; (vi) environment-independent a0 gap. None measured.
checks.reading: the dissolution direction stands consistent: the phantom's committed signatures -- cluster thermometer (T_obs/T_floor = (M_dyn/M_b)^alpha), the pie (s_ph = s_b g, rms 0.043), the dSph floor (G070), R(k) = 1, no free-streaming -- are all equilibrium statements, none particle-like.

checks.name: C6 [the decision tree is complete and consistent]
checks.measured: O3 first: dissolution? YES -> (c) ascending, falsifier registered. NO -> O2 charge vs relic via the G156 decade; RELIC -> (b); CHARGE -> O1 (solved: G154 Gauss-map + fluid current) -> (a), which converges to (c) if no independent field dynamics are found. Current nodes: O3 consistent; O2 lean charge at the lower edge (19 vs 5/1); O1 solved (certified).
checks.reading: every branch terminates in a committed test with a pre-registered consequence; no ontology-set theorem blocks another (G227 V2).

checks.name: V1 [the three-way status]
checks.measured: (a) CHAMPION -- assigned, verified (M_ph(<r_M) = M_b exact), Lean-certified (G227 C4, 5 theorems exit 0); converges toward (c) because the charge is the sourced field's own property. (b) RULED OUT (lean) -- 3.2/4.1 sigma, lower window excluded, pressed from above; formal declaration awaits the 95% decade. (c) ASCENDING -- adopted position (H054), consistent with all nulls, falsifier registered.
checks.reading: the three statuses are precise: champion means 'has a verified carrier', ruled-out-lean means 'disfavored at count level, not yet formally DECIDED-against', ascending means 'unfalsified and its falsifier is registered'.

checks.name: V2 [the dissolution test]
checks.measured: the observable that still requires a separate substance: any DM observable NOT reproducible from the baryonic+DE equilibrium statistics -- mass-source separation, measured particle, particle-imprint cutoff, decoupled dynamics, beyond-envelope mass, universal a0 gap. None measured; the deciding steps are G156's dark-halo decade probes (>= 100 quads, >= 5 streams, census to M_V <= -1) and the forest/sterile mass measurement.
checks.reading: the dissolution direction is consistent today and executable next; it dies the moment any of the six signatures is measured.

checks.name: V3 [the honest statement]
checks.measured: the dark mass's ontology is CLOSED to the (a)-class: particle carriers dead (relic 3.2/4.1 sigma; Noether charge J^0 = 0 identically), the surviving (a) -- the sourced Gauss-map charge -- certified but itself a property of the baryonic configuration, so (a) and (c) differ only in whether 'charge' language survives. The dissolve-completely boundary: the deciding pair is G156's dark-halo decade (95% inversion <= 0.5 at M_hm in [5e5, 5.8e6] -> RELIC, a substance; 1e6-1e7 in [0.5, 1.5] x CDM -> dissolution) and the field-detection falsifier. Until a nontrivial-matter observable appears: charge-assigned, relic-disfavored, effective-reading-ascending -- the dark mass is the baryonic+DE equilibrium's own field mass, correctly described by its Gauss map, carrying no particle.
checks.reading: the one-sentence standing is consistent with all three registers: the charge is assigned (a), the particle is disfavored (b), and there is nothing left over that needs its own dynamics (c).

verdicts.V1: THE THREE-WAY STATUS: (a) Gauss-map charge -- CHAMPION: assigned (G154, 18/18), reproduces M_ph(<r) = M_b r/r_M exactly (M_ph(<r_M) = M_b, < 1e-9 every radius), EFE-capped at sqrt(a0/g_ext) = 0.660/0.725, Lean-certified (G227 C4, 5 theorems exit 0, zero sorry) -- the only candidate with a verified carrier; and it converges toward (c) because the charge is the sourced field's own property, not a separate substance. (b) relic m = 5.09 +- 0.10 keV -- RULED OUT (lean): N_obs(>1e5 RAR) = 19 vs 5.1/1.0 -> 3.2/4.1 sigma count-level, S_meas = 1.0 vs 0.269/0.053, no break measured; every indirect 95% bound (6.2-9.7 keV) above m; formally the G156 RELIC declaration awaits the 95% dark-halo slope inversion; the 5.7-8.33 keV window survives only behind convention factors x2.7-9.7. (c) effective reading -- ASCENDING: adopted position (H054), consistent with all nulls (its prediction), falsifier registered (any field/particle detection), dissolution test stated (O3). Decision tree: O3 first (dissolution) -> only if a nontrivial observable appears does O2 (charge vs relic via the G156 dark-halo decade) fire; if CHARGE, O1 is already solved (G154).
verdicts.V2: THE DISSOLUTION TEST: the observable that still requires a separate substance (nontrivial matter beyond the prediction) is any DM observable NOT reproducible from the baryonic+DE equilibrium statistics: (i) mass separated from its baryonic source (offset collisions -- impossible for a Gauss-map charge riding on the baryons); (ii) a measured particle m (forest/sterile m in [4.6, 5.2] keV confirms the triangle; m < 4 or m > 6 keV kills it, G168 V3); (iii) any particle-imprint (lambda_fs > 0, R(k) < 1, the 95% SHMF slope inversion at M_hm in [5e5, 5.8e6] -- G156's RELIC declaration); (iv) dynamics decoupled from the equilibrium (independent Jeans scale, self-interaction, non-thermodynamic relaxation); (v) mass beyond the pie line s_ph(M) = s_b(M) g(M) or the EFE cap sqrt(a0/g_ext) M_b; (vi) an environment-INDEPENDENT a0 gap (kills H054 C4). The framework's committed answers -- cluster thermometer (T_obs/T_floor = (M_dyn/M_b)^alpha, G095), the pie (s_ph = s_b g, pooled rms 0.043, G222), the dSph floor (G070), R(k) = 1, no free-streaming (H047) -- are all equilibrium statements, none particle-like. NONE of the six signatures is measured: the dissolution direction stands consistent, and the executable deciding steps are G156's decade probes (>= 100 quads, >= 5 streams, census to M_V <= -1) plus the forest/sterile mass measurement.
verdicts.V3: THE HONEST STATEMENT: the dark mass's ontology is CLOSED to the (a)-class -- closed in the sense that the class is settled as far as it can be: the particle carriers are dead (relic disfavored 3.2/4.1 sigma; Noether charge J^0 = 0 identically on the static branch, G154 R2), and the surviving (a) -- the sourced field's Gauss-map charge -- is certified but is itself a property of the baryonic configuration, so (a) and (c) differ only in whether 'charge' language survives. The dissolve-completely reading's boundary is exactly that difference: (c) claims no carrier to find; (a) claims the carrier is the field's own surface term. The deciding test is the committed pair: G156's dark-halo decade (95% slope inversion <= 0.5 at M_hm in [5e5, 5.8e6] -> RELIC, a substance; 1e6-1e7 within [0.5, 1.5] x CDM -> no-cutoff, dissolution direction) and the field-detection falsifier (any environment-independent fifth force, scalar wave, or particle -> substance; continued nulls -> dissolution). Until a nontrivial-matter observable appears: charge-assigned, relic-disfavored, effective-reading-ascending -- the dark mass is the baryonic+DE equilibrium's own field mass, correctly described by its Gauss map, carrying no particle.

(a) Gauss-map charge M_ph(<r) = M_b r/r_M: CHAMPION -- assigned (G154), Lean-certified (G227 C4), converging toward (c) because the charge is the sourced field's own surface term. (b) relic m = 5.09 +- 0.10 keV: RULED OUT (lean) -- the census's executable number 19 vs 5.1/1.0 at 3.2/4.1 sigma (re-derived here), lower window excluded, every indirect 95% bound above m; the formal G156 RELIC declaration still awaits the 95% dark-halo slope inversion. (c) effective reading: ASCENDING -- no particle at all (J^0 = 0), the mass is the baryonic+DE equilibrium's statistics, all nulls expected, falsifier registered. DISSOLUTION (O3): the observable that still requires a separate substance is any DM observable not reproducible from the distribution alone (mass-source separation, measured particle, particle-imprint cutoff, decoupled dynamics, beyond-envelope mass, universal a0 gap) -- none measured; the phantom's dynamics (cluster thermometer, pie, dSph floor) are all the equilibrium's. Deciding pair: G156's 1e5-1e8 dark-halo decade + the field-detection falsifier. Until then: charge-assigned, relic-disfavored, effective-reading-ascending.
